description: Curated interview question bank for the QA Engineer role. Each question is tagged with a difficulty level and the skill dimension it probes.

questions.text: What is the difference between functional testing and non-functional testing? Give an example of each.
Explain black-box and white-box testing, and when you would use each.
What is the difference between a unit test, an integration test, and an end-to-end test?
What makes a good automated test, and what makes one flaky?
What is the difference between a bug, a defect, and a failure?
What information should a good bug report contain, and why does each part matter?
How do you decide what to test when you cannot test everything before a release?
Explain boundary value analysis and equivalence partitioning with an example.
How do you choose what to automate and what to leave as manual testing?
A test suite takes an hour and fails often for unrelated reasons. How do you fix it?
How do you test a feature when the requirements are vague or incomplete?
A critical bug is found the day before release. Walk through how you decide whether to ship, fix, or delay.
Design a test strategy for a payment checkout flow, covering happy path, edge cases, and failure modes.
How do you test for performance and load, and what numbers do you actually watch?
Explain the test pyramid, and what goes wrong when a team has it upside down.
How do you test code that depends on external APIs and databases without making tests slow or fragile?
How do you measure the quality of a release, and what would make you say it is not ready?
A production incident was caused by a bug your tests missed. How do you investigate it and stop the same class of bug from reaching production again?
